archetypes.name: dyn-awk-segments
archetypes.rationale: The AWK scanner now walks multiple command segments and pipe-fed state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the updated lint-bare-grep-probe AWK scanner for segment-boundary mistakes. Focus on quoted operators, pipe-fed stdin tracking for | and |&, and whether a safe earlier grep-family candidate can hide a later unsafe candidate. Check that bare grep detection remains correct for RHS fallback segments without regressing subshell-safe forms. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
